sloka: प्रयाता रजनी देवि सूर्यस्योदयनं प्रति ।अभिषेकं गुरुजन्स्त्वरयीष्यति मां ध्रुवम् ॥२-१४-१५॥
transliteration: prayātā rajanī devi sūryasyodayanaṁ prati ।abhiṣekaṁ gurujanstvarayīṣyati māṁ dhruvam ॥2-14-15॥

translations.english: O queen the night has departed and the Sun is about to rise. The preceptors now will definitely ask me to hasten for the consecration.
